status.nb: 22 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 52 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Manila, Philippine og Davao.

summary.en: Chinese coast guard and navy vessels are intensifying combat-readiness patrols, water-cannon drills, and a carrier group including Liaoning has entered the western Pacific, prompting alarms from the Philippines, Taiwan and Japan. The Philippine Coast Guard is delivering fuel to Filipino fishermen at Scarborough Shoal and jointly conducting a search-and-rescue exercise with the US Coast Guard in the West Philippine Sea, while a ferry listing off Quezon Province was rescued, saving 58 passengers. Taiwan reports Chinese coast guard ships harassing shipping and entering Dongsha restricted waters. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske kystvakts- og marineskip intensiverer beredskapspatruljer, vannkanonøvelser, og en flåtegruppe med Liaoning har gått inn i det vestlige Stillehavet, noe som vekker alarm i Filippinene, Taiwan og Japan. Filippinsk kystvakt leverer drivstoff til filippinske fiskere ved Scarborough-revet og gjennomfører i fellesskap en søk- og redningsøvelse med USAs kystvakt i Vestfilippinske hav, mens en ferge som kantet i Quezon-provinsen ble reddet, og 58 passasjerer ble reddet. Taiwan melder om kinesiske kystvaktskip som trakasserer skipstrafikk og går inn i Dongsha-sperrede farvann. 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
